home.why.title: Why race with us
home.why.grid.title: One grid, 22 cockpits
home.why.grid.text: 11 teams with 2 regular drivers each plus an ordered reserve pool. Absent drivers are replaced – every race with a full field.
home.why.crossplay.title: Crossplay
home.why.crossplay.text: PC, PlayStation and Xbox race together in one lobby. Wheel or controller – both are welcome.
home.why.stewards.title: Transparent stewards
home.why.stewards.text: Every decision is public – with reasoning, clip and reference number. Stewards involved in an incident never decide it.
home.why.archive.title: Season archive
home.why.archive.text: All results, standings and records are kept – including a Hall of Fame and all-time leaderboards.
home.why.numbers.title: Permanent race numbers
home.why.numbers.text: Pick your number and keep it. Your stats follow you from season to season.
home.why.community.title: Community
home.why.community.text: Discord is our paddock: coordination, race-day chat and a team that runs the league with passion.
home.discord.title: Community on Discord
home.discord.text: Coordination, sign-offs, race-day chat: the league’s paddock is our Discord server.
